info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens Tasks API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor for pagination to get the next page of results.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a page of task engagement records. Use the limit and after parameters to paginate through tasks. You can also specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

Creates a new task engagement record with the provided properties. Common task properties include hs_task_subject, hs_task_body, hs_task_status, hs_task_priority, hs_task_type, and hs_timestamp for the due date.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The ID of the task to retrieve.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a single task engagement record by its ID. You can specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The ID of the task to update.

items.docs: Performs a partial update of a task engagement record. Only the properties included in the request body will be updated.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The ID of the task to archive.

items.docs: Archives (soft deletes) a task engagement record by its ID. Archived tasks can be restored using the HubSpot UI or API.
Searches for task engagement records using filter groups, sorts, and other query parameters.
